settings.content: Shows an informational promotion without links or product selectors. The native discount is store-wide; set its real percentage, minimum quantity, eligible collection and dates in Shopify Discounts. Display text must match those rules.

Eligible case collection
settings.info: Must match the collection selected in Shopify Discounts.

settings.info: Keep off until you want to recommend accessories. The case promotion is managed separately under Case offer.

settings.label: Default products to pair
settings.info: Used when a pairing block and the product Upsell products metafield have no selection. Choose compatible cases, wallets, lanyards, or other products.

settings.content: The sale starts November 17 and runs through November 30 in New York time. Theme dates control presentation only. Set matching dates in Shopify Discounts. Publishing the theme is a separate manual action.

settings.label: Sale start date
settings.info: YYYY-MM-DD. Publish the approved theme at the opening time on November 17.

settings.label: Sale start time
settings.info: 24-hour time in the selected timezone. 00:00 means midnight at the beginning of the start date.

settings.label: Sale end date
settings.info: YYYY-MM-DD. December 1 at 00:00 keeps the sale open for all of Cyber Monday, November 30.

settings.label: Sale end time
settings.info: 24-hour time. Match the end timestamp in Shopify Discounts.

settings.content: Preview modes affect only the theme editor and never apply coupons. A live preview needs an end date to show the end countdown.

settings.label: Test discounts in unpublished theme
settings.info: Shows live offers for review outside the theme editor. Ignored on a published theme. The Shopify codes themselves are store-wide; deactivate them after testing.

settings.label: Enable Black Friday cart offers
settings.info: Enables the cart controls during the sale or unpublished-theme testing. Shopify discount records must also be active.

settings.label: Keep signup popup disabled
settings.info: WELCOME10 stays available from the cart before, during and after the sale.

settings.content: Product countdown styling. Days appear when 24 hours or more remain, and seconds update live. Edit announcement text and reminder dates in its Countdown block under Header > ZOOTIFY announcement bar.
